text:
arjun: Starting change window 22:00 UTC. Scope: router header-split flip (x-rd-routing) + runtime kernel_batched=true in opt-in cluster. Need api pinned to v2.14.2 before we flip. Canaries: 3 phases (5% 10m -> 50% 15m -> 100%).

leigh: Ack. Console PR queued with release blurb and rollback steps. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pull/4180

anya: pinned api to v2.14.2 in prod. Confirmed deploy tag present in release registry.

deploybot: created wave wb-172930-A for services: api, router, runtime, console. Canary=5% for 10m.

arjun: Preflight checklist: api pin  done, console note done, runtime image pushed, router flag ready in staging, observability panel live.

monitor-bot: dashboard link: https://obs.redwood/dash/910 - watching x-rd-routing split ratio, api 5xx, runtime pod restarts. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

tomas: runtime image pushed to canary pool. Quick smoke in staging: p95 latency -8ms, throughput +6%. CPU increase ~5% on some nodes.

deploybot: runtime rollout initiated to canary pool (job id rb-172930-rt). Canary nodes: 8.

leigh: flipping router header to split-v2 on 5% canary now. curl test executed.

anya: curl checks from canary passes, health endpoints return 200.

monitor-bot: early metrics t+3m: api 5xx = 0.04% (baseline 0.03%), p95 +9ms. No alerts yet.

arjun: keep an eye on pod restarts. If restarts >2 in 10m in canary, we'll pause and investigate.

tomas: seeing a single runtime pod OOM on shard-3 at t+6m, pod auto-restarted. I've increased JVM Xmx on that shard for the canary.

deploybot: canary progressed to 50% as of t+12m. Noted one runtime restart and one transient 502 from router during a connection drain.

monitor-bot: aggregated: p95 increased 18% in canary, 5xx remained below 0.5% (0.07%). Trend stable.

leigh: added small note to release_notes.md: "Router: header-based split routing rollout (x-rd-routing). Runtime: enable kernel batching (opt-in). See console for enabling and metrics."

arjun: proceeding to 100% after 5 more stable minutes. Rollback criteria reminder: api 5xx >0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 >30% increase OR >3 pod restarts in 10m.

deploybot: rollout to 100% completed for api/router/runtime/console. Wave wb-172930-A closed.

monitor-bot: post-rollout summary t+30m: api 5xx 0.05%, p95 +11ms, runtime pod restarts normalized. No incidents.

anya: publishing release note and emailing support/SRE with summary and links to the runbook.

arjun: thanks team. If any after-hours regressions, escalate to #eng-oncall and follow rollback runbook.
